## Overview

Primal magic is not a different kind of magic  -  it is the **same arcane energy** from B's sacrifice, but filtered through the natural world. When B's essence spread across the material plane, nature itself absorbed it. Trees, stone, rivers, soil, beasts, and even mortals  -  all became imbued with arcane potential.

## How It Works

While wizards draw directly from the weave through study and precision, druids, rangers, and barbarians draw from the weave **as it manifests through nature**.

- **Druids** attune to the arcane energy that flows through living things  -  plants, animals, the seasons, the cycle of life and decay
- **Rangers** draw from the wild places and their connection to the natural world
- **Barbarians** channel raw, unfiltered arcane energy through primal emotion and instinct  -  their rage is magic, surging through them without control or finesse

## The Universal Truth (Secret)

The most important secret the gods keep hidden is this: **all mortals have latent arcane potential**. The weave flows through every living being. While some individuals are born with a naturally stronger connection (sorcerers), the capacity to learn magic is not exclusive to any bloodline, class, or calling.

Any mortal, given the right teaching, time, and discipline, could learn to cast spells.

The gods suppress this knowledge because it would free mortals from dependence on divine intermediaries. If mortals knew they could access the weave directly  -  without prayer, without temples, without gods  -  the entire structure of divine power would collapse.

## The Birth of Native Monsters

The same arcane absorption that gave nature its magic also **transformed Kythoria's wildlife**. Over centuries, ambient arcane energy caused ordinary animals to mutate into monstrous forms. This gave rise to Kythoria's **native monsters**:

- **Dragons**  -  The pinnacle of arcane evolution. Apex predators that emerged as natural wildlife absorbed arcane energy over millennia. They are not invaders; they are native to Kythoria. Their connection to B's essence runs especially deep  -  this is the true origin of the draconic hoarding instinct, a manifestation of the same subconscious pull that affects all creatures touched by B's influence.
- **Owlbears, basilisks, manticores, griffons, and similar creatures**  -  Natural animals warped by arcane mutation into magical beasts.
- These creatures existed long before the planar breaches opened. They are not allied with the invasion monsters, though they may compete for territory or be pressed into service.

This phenomenon is a direct consequence of the Great Sacrifice  -  B's essence did not only create the weave and the crystals, but also seeped into the very biology of the natural world, creating a menagerie of magical life.

## Implications

- The existence of druids and rangers is proof that nature itself can teach magic  -  the gods cannot easily suppress it because it arises organically from the world
- Druidic circles and isolated natural orders may hold pieces of the truth without fully understanding it
- A mortal who discovers this secret could theoretically learn to cast without a god, without a spellbook  -  purely by attuning to the weave within themselves
- The same arcane energy that empowers druids also gave rise to dragons and other native monsters  -  a reminder that B's gift was not purely benevolent, but a wild and unpredictable force
